title.zh: Coinbase、Circle等发起的代币化资产联盟推出代币化证券DeFi可组合性框架GAP
title.en: Coinbase、Circle等发起的代币化资产联盟推出代币化证券DeFi可组合性框架GAP

current_state.zh: The Coinbase- and Circle-backed Tokenized Asset Coalition launched the Global Access Protocol (GAP), a framework for DeFi composability of tokenized securities developed with input from US regulators, and added 12 new members.
current_state.en: The Coinbase- and Circle-backed Tokenized Asset Coalition launched the Global Access Protocol (GAP), a framework for DeFi composability of tokenized securities developed with input from US regulators, and added 12 new members.
